name: Image Compressor
summary: Compress images with quality and max-size controls, then download a smaller file — in your browser.
description: Drop a photo, pick quality and optional max dimension, choose JPEG/WebP/PNG output, and compare before/after file sizes. Compression uses the Canvas API locally so nothing is uploaded.

faqs.question: Is my image uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Compression runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: JPEG, WebP, or PNG?
faqs.answer: JPEG and WebP shrink photos best. PNG is lossless and may not get smaller.

faqs.question: Does this remove EXIF?
faqs.answer: Re-encoding drops most metadata. Use EXIF Remover when privacy is the main goal.
